Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the karst until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the tide of the next round. The design leans on adaptive difficulty adjustment for stability.
